## 4. Control of staff cars and responsibilities of Controlling Officers  
The staff car will be under the administrative control of an officer not below the rank of an Under Secretary who will act as a Controlling Officer 10t  
in respect of the car. 229nlbnoini-o#9ymonon9 lsu1sinogdi1onoi16ool
